name: Iwakura Ren
source:
A girl that doesn't seem to have much interest in the opposite sex.

[spoiler]The main protagonist during Chapter 3.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]She was adopted into a wealthy family by Aarata Iwakura, owner of Iwakura Castle. She is an advisor at Ina Holdings.[/spoiler]
